body.to_status: <each of the six edges in turn>

api_checks.description: AC-04 / E3-S1 AC1: each of the six valid edges in ticket-lifecycle_spec.md Section 2 (OPEN->IN_PROGRESS, IN_PROGRESS->PENDING_CUSTOMER, PENDING_CUSTOMER->RESOLVED, RESOLVED->CLOSED, IN_PROGRESS->RESOLVED, and PENDING_CUSTOMER->OPEN via customer reply) returns 200 and writes exactly one TicketHistory row recording from-state, to-state and actor. Verified live by walking one ticket through OPEN->IN_PROGRESS->PENDING_CUSTOMER->RESOLVED->CLOSED and a second ticket through IN_PROGRESS->RESOLVED and PENDING_CUSTOMER->OPEN (the last via POST /api/tickets/{id}/replies, see AC-08 checks below).
AC-04 / E3-S1 AC2: an edge outside the six valid edges (OPEN -> RESOLVED) returns 409 INVALID_TICKET_STATE, the status is unchanged, and no history row is written.

AC-04 / E3-S1 AC3: any write (claim, note, reply) to a CLOSED ticket returns 409 TICKET_CLOSED_IMMUTABLE. A status-transition attempt on a CLOSED ticket returns 409 INVALID_TICKET_STATE instead (ticket-lifecycle_spec.md AC-04 draws this distinction explicitly: the status endpoint reports the edge as invalid, every other write reports the ticket as immutable). Both were verified live on the same CLOSED ticket.
AC-03 / E3-S2 AC1: claiming an OPEN ticket returns 200, sets the assignee, moves status to IN_PROGRESS, and writes one Assignment row with from=null.
AC-03 / E3-S2 AC2: reassigning an already-claimed ticket returns 200, status is unchanged, and a second Assignment row records the previous assignee in from and the new one in to.
AC-03 / E3-S2 AC3: a write carrying a stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

AC-07 / E3-S3 AC1: an assigned agent's note returns 201 and the body never appears in GET /api/tickets/{id} or GET /api/tickets when called with the owning customer's token (notes array is empty for customers).
AC-07 / E3-S3 AC2: an agent's public reply returns 201 and is visible in the customer's GET /api/tickets/{id} replies array.
AC-07 / E3-S3 AC3: PUT, PATCH and DELETE on a note id or a reply id all return 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED and change no row. Verified for all three methods against both a note id and a reply id.

AC-08 / E3-S4 AC1: the ticket's owning customer replying while the ticket is PENDING_CUSTOMER returns 201, moves the status to OPEN, and writes one TicketHistory row (PENDING_CUSTOMER -> OPEN) in the same transaction as the reply insert.
AC-08 / E3-S4 AC2: a customer reply on a ticket already OPEN or IN_PROGRESS returns 201 and leaves the status unchanged.
AC-08 / E3-S4 AC3: a customer reply on a RESOLVED (or CLOSED) ticket returns 409 INVALID_TICKET_STATE and writes no reply row.
AC-08 / E3-S4 AC3: a customer replying on another customer's ticket returns 404 (never 403), per api-contracts.md's cross-customer rule.

playwright_checks.description: Through the real browser: customer creates a ticket, agent1 claims it from the ticket page (assignee/status update in place), agent1 reassigns it to AG-2, agent2 adds an internal note, and the note is confirmed invisible on the customer's own view of the same ticket while the ticket remains otherwise visible (title, status, reply box).

steps.action: login as customer1 and create a Technical/Medium ticket
login as agent1, open the ticket, click Claim
steps.assertion: ticket-assignee no longer reads Unassigned; ticket-status reads IN_PROGRESS

steps.action: fill Reassign to (user id) with AG-2 and submit
login as agent2, open the ticket, add an internal note
steps.assertion: note body visible under Internal notes

steps.action: login as customer1, open the same ticket
steps.assertion: note body is absent (0 matches); no Internal notes or History sections render; only title/status/reply box are present

playwright_checks.description: Group D's committed frontend/e2e/functional.spec.ts, which exercises the same Group B backend endpoints through the UI: ticket creation, agent claim from the workbench, a stale-version 409 surfaced as an error banner, AC-08's customer-reply-on-PENDING_CUSTOMER transition to OPEN, and a CLOSED ticket rendering read-only.

Verified by `uv run lint-imports` passing with zero violations.
